params.topic: Japan J1 League 2018-2025 continuation: resolve remaining row-level historical data gaps only
questions: MANDATORY SCOPE GATE: Japan J1 League / J.League Division 1 only, country=Japan, seasons=[2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025], total expected fixtures=2670. Exclude Bundesliga/Germany, J2, J3, Emperor's Cup, Levain Cup and every non-J1 competition. Return this scope confirmation before any rows.

Do not repeat the prior methodology-only report. Attempt actual row-level recovery and return evidence rows whenever a source is accessible. If a row cannot be verified, return an explicit unavailable row and reason.

ODDS GAP: for each J1 fixture and each bookmaker separately (bet365, pinnacle, williamhill), recover the earliest directly evidenced pre-match 1X2 observation and the latest directly evidenced pre-kickoff 1X2 observation. Required fields: stable_match_key, season, date, kickoff_local if available, home, away, bookmaker, market=1x2, observation_role, recorded_at, pre_match_marker, home_odds, draw_odds, away_odds, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256. observation_role must be one of earliest_verified_pre_match, latest_verified_pre_match, closing_anchor, preclosing_snapshot, unavailable. Do not call any closing or football-data B365H/PSH/WHH pre-closing snapshot true opening.

Prioritize the known local 642 unavailable 5DollarFootballAPI odds fields from 2021-2025 and return only directly evidenced replacements or conflicts for those cells. Keep Bet365, Pinnacle and William Hill separate, keep opening/interval/preclosing/closing semantics separate, and never overwrite conflicting values automatically.

IDENTITY GAP: resolve the 48 J1 fixtures without a provider fixture ID using season/date/home/away. Return exactly one stable_match_key and provider ID only when the match identity is unambiguous; otherwise preserve unresolved with the competing candidates and source evidence.

STANDINGS GAP: for every fixture, recover the pre-kickoff home and away rank_before, points_before and played_before from an official or clearly dated previous-round/dated snapshot. Record snapshot_date, snapshot_time or time_status, ranking_rule, source_url, field_locator and source_sha256. First-round values may be points_before=0 and played_before=0 only when round identity is directly verified; rank_before stays unavailable unless the source defines it. Same-day ordering, postponed matches and tied-rank ambiguity must be marked rather than guessed. Do not use final-season standings as pre-match data.
OPTIONAL SECONDARY GAP: check whether row-level 2018-2020 J1 over/under 2.5 odds exist in the same sources; return only directly evidenced rows and keep this separate from 1X2.

Use source priority: official J.League Data Site for fixture and standings snapshots; NowScore/Titan007, BetExplorer or OddsPortal for historical bookmaker observations when the page exposes the actual row; football-data.co.uk only as explicitly labelled pre-closing or closing evidence. Prefer browser-capable page inspection for JavaScript-rendered tables. Do not infer values from search snippets.

Do not return or infer qimen_output, nine-palace values, F relation, G energy, I cycle/intent, natal_year, Miss 1/Miss 2, BTTS, probabilities, or any outcome-derived field. Those remain local workflow fields and must not be fabricated by this request.

Return JSON report plus row-level evidence and unresolved_queue. Include per-target audit expected/discovered/complete/partial/unavailable/blocked/conflict counts, source provenance, retrieval time and response SHA. Preserve NULLs and conflicts. Output is supplement/Shadow evidence only; formal Snapshot, Outcome, Review, Gold, probabilities, weights and existing SQLite must remain unchanged.
